mapper.select: SELECT EQP_ID,TECH_LIST,FAB,UPDATE_TIME,PATH_FLAG,MODULE,EQP_G,UTIL FROM( SELECT A.*,NVL(B.MODULE,C.MODULE)MODULE,NVL(B.EQP_G,C.EQP_G)EQP_G,D.UTIL FROM( SELECT KEY1 EQP_ID,F_COMMENT TECH_LIST,KEY3 FAB,UPDATE_TIME ,DECODE(F_COMMENT,NULL,'N','Y') PATH_FLAG FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'CIS_PATH_MONITOR' )A LEFT JOIN PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD B ON A.EQP_ID = B.EQP_ID AND A.FAB = B.FAB_PHASE LEFT JOIN PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 C ON A.EQP_ID = C.EQP_ID AND A.FAB = C.FAB_PHASE LEFT JOIN( SELECT EQP_ID,ROUND(UTIL_DTH*100,1)||'%' UTIL FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_STATUS_DAILY WHERE SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') UNION ALL SELECT EQP_ID,ROUND(UTIL_DTH*100,1)||'%' UTIL FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_STATUS_DAILY_A3 WHERE SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') )D ON A.EQP_ID = D.EQP_ID )ORDER BY MODULE,EQP_G,EQP_ID

SELECT EQP_ID,EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG,MODULE,EQP_G,FAB_PHASE ,CASE WHEN MODULE = 'ETCH' AND SUBSTR(EQP_ID,1,3) IN ('EAM','EBM','EAK','EBK') AND INSTR(EQP_ID,'.') > 0 THEN 'N' WHEN B.EQP_ID_ACT IS NOT NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END FLAG FROM( SELECT EQP_ID,EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG,MODULE,EQP_G,FAB_PHASE FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD WHERE EQP_ID = #{eqpId} UNION ALL SELECT EQP_ID,EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG,MODULE,EQP_G,FAB_PHASE FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 WHERE EQP_ID = #{eqpId} )A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT KEY1 EQP_ID_ACT FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'CIS_PATH_MONITOR' )B ON A.EQP_ID = B.EQP_ID_ACT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY(FUNCTION_NAME,KEY1,KEY2,KEY3,UPDATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER) SELECT 'CIS_PATH_MONITOR'FUNCTION_NAME,#{EQP_ID} KEY1, #{MODULE} KEY2,#{FAB_PHASE} KEY3,SYSDATE UPDATE_TIME,#{UPDATE_USER} UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL
mapper.select: DELETE FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'CIS_PATH_MONITOR' AND KEY1 = #{eqpId}

INSERT INTO A1MFG.CIS_DEDICATE_MONITOR_HIS(SHIFT_DATE,SHIFT_HOUR,EQP_ID,TECH_LIST,FAB,PATH_FLAG,MODULE,EQP_G,UTIL,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD')SHIFT_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'HH24')SHIFT_HOUR,EQP_ID,TECH_LIST,FAB,PATH_FLAG,MODULE,EQP_G,UTIL,'system'UPDATE_USER,SYSDATE UPDATE_TIME FROM( SELECT A.*,NVL(B.MODULE,C.MODULE)MODULE,NVL(B.EQP_G,C.EQP_G)EQP_G,D.UTIL FROM( SELECT KEY1 EQP_ID,F_COMMENT TECH_LIST,KEY3 FAB,UPDATE_TIME ,DECODE(F_COMMENT,NULL,'N','Y') PATH_FLAG FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'CIS_PATH_MONITOR' )A LEFT JOIN PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD B ON A.EQP_ID = B.EQP_ID AND A.FAB = B.FAB_PHASE LEFT JOIN PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 C ON A.EQP_ID = C.EQP_ID AND A.FAB = C.FAB_PHASE LEFT JOIN( SELECT EQP_ID,ROUND(UTIL_DTH*100,1)||'%' UTIL FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_STATUS_DAILY WHERE SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') UNION ALL SELECT EQP_ID,ROUND(UTIL_DTH*100,1)||'%' UTIL FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_STATUS_DAILY_A3 WHERE SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD') )D ON A.EQP_ID = D.EQP_ID )WHERE PATH_FLAG = 'Y'

SELECT A.PRODG1,B.PRODUCTID,B.ROUTEID,B.OPENO,B.EQUIPMENTID,B.PASS_FLG_PRC,B.PRC_UPT_USER,B.PRC_UPT_TIME,B.PASS_FLG_MFG,B.MFG_UPT_USER,B.MFG_UPT_TIME FROM( SELECT PRODG1,PRODSPEC_ID FROM PWEB.PRODUCT WHERE PRODG1 LIKE 'L11%' )A JOIN( SELECT PRODUCTID,ROUTEID,OPENO,EQUIPMENTID,PASS_FLG_PRC,PRC_UPT_USER,PRC_UPT_TIME,PASS_FLG_MFG,MFG_UPT_USER,MFG_UPT_TIME FROM( SELECT EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD WHERE EQP_G ='FP_Fpoly' AND ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' )A LEFT JOIN MM.CSFRINHIBIT B ON A.EQP_ID = B.EQUIPMENTID WHERE (B.PASS_FLG_PRC ='Y' OR B.PASS_FLG_MFG ='Y') AND OPENO = '1G.FFP10' )B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODUCTID
